title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-29
source: matrix of SBD: shnid=33565 and AUD: shnid=26568

ai_review.summary: An almost perfect matrix recording of the historic April 29 1971 Fillmore East show, highlighted by a smoking Alligator, early‑era Bird Song and Phil Lesh’s thunderous bass work.
ai_review.review: The recording captures the legendary final night at the Fillmore East in crystal‑clear matrix quality, preserving every nuance of the band. Musically the performance is fire‑hot – from the fresh Bird Song to the last‑ever version of Alligator that starts loose but erupts into a monster jam, with Phil’s bass singled out as a standout element. Overall it feels like an essential addition for any Deadhead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers give five stars and rave about both the superb musical performance and the excellent matrix recording; the combination of high show energy and top‑tier sound quality warrants an exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the matrix as one of the best kinds – clear, well balanced and almost flawless, with only minor “mistakes here and there” that do not detract from enjoyment.

standout_songs: St. Stephen jam tease leading into GDTRFB
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set blends classic covers and early‑era originals with strong momentum; the second set opens powerfully and builds to a climactic Alligator/St. Stephen jam, showcasing tight transitions and sustained energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned as part of the core characters and noted playing pedal steel during the New Riders segment; overall performance praised.
band_member_comments.Phil: His bass work is highlighted repeatedly – “Phil’s part alone makes it five” and “Phil bombs,” indicating a standout contribution.
band_member_comments.Bob: Included among the core characters with no specific critique, implying solid rhythm guitar/vocals.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pig (Ron "Pigpen" McKernan) is listed among the characters, suggesting his keyboard/harmonica work was present and satisfactory.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill (drummer) is referenced as part of the core lineup; no detailed comments but implied competent performance.
